title: 6 Signs a Godly Man's Humility Is Real and Not a Performance
caption:
6 signs a godly man's humility is real and not a performance.

He can be corrected in front of other people. He gives the credit away before anyone has to pry it out of him. He can lose an argument and still sleep fine.

He who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted (Luke 14:11). No stage version. One guy, same size everywhere.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #humility #character
